name: appmixer.arcmira.core.ResolveEntities
description: Resolve a name, handle or YouTube URL to entity candidates. Exact best matches go to resolved; suggestions, fuzzy and ambiguous matches go to review without choosing one. Returns every candidate and the API guidance. Uses no credits. API docs: https://arcmira.com/docs.
author: Arcmira <zeal@arcmira.com>

query.label: Query
query.tooltip: A name, @handle, YouTube URL or channel id (UC...). One thing per call.

type.label: Type
type.tooltip: Restrict candidates to one type. Pass channel for a show and read best.youtube_channel_id.

context.label: Context
context.tooltip: What the user said about the name, in their words ("the startup bank", "Canada's prime minister", "on My First Million"). Ranks candidates by their description and by the episodes they share with what the context names; a clear winner comes back as suggested with reason context.

example.note: Synthetic example: ask which entity the user means.

error.message: Synthetic example: the configured usage limit has been reached.
